ideas.pitch: A web-based interactive puzzle chase platform explicitly styled after the Chernobyl 1986 lockdown, featuring multi-domain engineering riddles.
ideas.problem_statement: Operation Blackout is a high-stakes, timed puzzle chase set in the frozen universe of Wormwood at 1:23 a.m. on 26 April 1986, requiring teams to solve sequential engineering and scientific challenges.
ideas.title: Wormwood 1986 Chrono-Puzzle Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core event theme and mechanics of Operation Blackout, offering organizers an engaging companion or training platform for their timed puzzle chase format.

ideas.pitch: An AI-guided terminal assistant that parses messy engineering constraints, circuit diagrams, and genetic sequences under tight time limits.
ideas.problem_statement: Operation Blackout requires teams to think like an alchemist, circuit designer, signal engineer, and gene hunter within minutes under a shared 90-minute countdown.
ideas.title: Prima Materia Alchemical Solver Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of high-utility live-demo tools by solving the exact high-pressure multi-disciplinary puzzle constraints of the hackathon theme.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-fire circuit and signal debugging mini-game that trains participants to bypass corrupted systems before the reactor core overloads.
ideas.problem_statement: Operation Blackout challenges teams with circuit design and signal engineering hurdles under extreme time pressure and penalty clocks for wrong turns.
ideas.title: Reactor 4 Circuit & Signal Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a fully functional, highly polished live demo that matches the specific engineering branches highlighted in the Wormwood scenario.

ideas.pitch: An agentic dashboard tracking multiple parallel timeline states and penalty countdown timers for teams navigating the multi-world puzzle chase.
ideas.problem_statement: Operation Blackout takes place in the Multiverse of Matter where thousands of parallel worlds exist, tracked through a rigorous and unforgiving 90-minute game countdown.
ideas.title: Multiverse of Matter Parallel World Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an agentic architecture pattern proven to win fast-paced hackathons, tailored specifically to the narrative scale of Wormwood's parallel realities.

ideas.pitch: A specialized string-matching and biological sequence puzzle utility designed to quickly decode rogue scientist logs and genetic lock codes.
ideas.problem_statement: Operation Blackout requires teams to act as gene hunters to unlock the sequence protecting the stolen Prima Materia before time runs out.
ideas.title: Gene Hunter Sequence Decoder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an impeccably working, domain-specific tool that directly addresses one of the four core pillars of the event's multidisciplinary challenge.
